Surface: In addition to the condition comments mentioned on 7/12/12; there is a small black mark at the center left in the land portion, several small and minor brown marks at center left in the water, and a series of intermittent abrasions and discoloration along the bottom edge. 
 
Frame: The new frame has intermittent scratches throughout and areas of minor loss at the upper left corner and the lower right corner.

remarks_1999: Double entries Abiquiú Notebooks. Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1934. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 dates 1935. Dated 1937 on basis of inclusion in 1937–38 New York (An American Place) exhibition and Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. See cat. nos. 851, 1987, 1990, 1991, 2017–20. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: The smooth, pale blue form of the Chama River rushes through the center of the composition, flanked by vibrant green banks. Tan hills dotted with green bushes rise from the banks. A blue mountain is visible in the distance, stretching out below a strip of pale white sky.
title: Chama River, Ghost Ranch
